# LanXgrow

> English communication and interview preparation information for students, freshers and working professionals.

LanXgrow's public website explains the learning approach and offers guided demonstrations. Scripted responses and optional browser-local rehearsals are demonstrations. Live AI feedback and automated assessment reports are planned. These demonstrations do not establish learner scores or hiring outcomes.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.lanxgrow.com/): Learning approach and public experience overview.
- [About](https://www.lanxgrow.com/about): Purpose, philosophy and research context.
- [Services](https://www.lanxgrow.com/services): English communication focus and programme enquiries.
- [Interview preparation](https://www.lanxgrow.com/interview-prep): Illustrative practice framework for career goals.
- [SMART AI demonstrations](https://www.lanxgrow.com/smart-ai): Guided scripted conversation and optional local rehearsal.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.lanxgrow.com/faq): Availability, fees, privacy and getting started.
- [Privacy](https://www.lanxgrow.com/privacy): Published privacy information.
- [Terms](https://www.lanxgrow.com/terms): Published terms of use.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Public website guide](https://www.lanxgrow.com/agent-guide.json): Read-only page directory and capability status; not an assessment API.
- [Agentic resource discovery manifest](https://www.lanxgrow.com/.well-known/ard.json): Catalog of the public guide.
- [Sitemap](https://www.lanxgrow.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages.

## Programme enquiries

Email official@lanxgrow.com to confirm current availability, curriculum, fees and schedules before enrolling. Account sign-in and private learner information are separate from this public guide. No account records, recordings or payment actions are exposed by these resources.
